name: Sayo Ronoroa
source:
The Student Council President of Maria St. Claire Institute and the sole candidate for the Highest Honors in her batch.

Always maintains a set of principles to follow in both normal and crisis situations. She keeps a journal, which she dedicates herself to writing every day. Has an interest in psychoanalysis; hence, her secret interest in playing poker.

[spoiler]Depending on how the story will play out, she may or may not be the true identity behind L.C.[/spoiler]
